decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - No deliveries shall be taken at or despatched from the site outside the hours of 8am to 8pm nor at any time on Sundays, Bank or Public Holidays.

Condition : 4 - Before the development hereby permitted is commenced a scheme indicating the provision to be made for disabled people to gain access to the additional retail unit shall have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The agreed scheme shall be implemented before the development hereby permitted is brought into use.
Condition : 5 - The retail units hereby approved shall remain as independent units and shall not be enlarged without the written agreement of the Local Planning Authority

Condition : 6 - The development shall not be occupied until a secure storage area within the site enclosed by a two metre high close boarded fence to house one 1100 litre galvanised steel Eurobin has been identified and made available, together with facilities for the separation and storage of glass, metal, plastics, cardboard, food waste and other recyclable materials which shall then be collected and taken to a suitable facility for recycling.  The storage area and bins shall be made permanently available before the development is first occupied and no waste shall be stored outside the site or other than in the designated area.  The lids of the Eurobin shall be kept shut at all times other than when waste is being emptied into them.  Non-recyclable and perishable waste shall be removed from site no less frequently than once a week.
Condition : 7 - The amended loading, unloading and turning and parking spaces shall be laid out and completed within three calender months of the permission hereby granted.
description: Sub-division of the existing unit to provide two new retail units.
